integratedDiagnostics.title: Process diagnostics
integratedDiagnostics.description: Inspect the local Java process, even when the server cannot connect.
integratedDiagnostics.openDirectoryError: Could not open the data directory
integratedDiagnostics.quiet: No new output for {{count}} seconds. Startup may still be working. Capture a thread dump to see what Java is doing.
integratedDiagnostics.dumpHelp: Captures platform and virtual threads without stopping Java. The request times out after 15 seconds.
integratedDiagnostics.jcmdHelp: Thread dumps need jcmd from JDK 25. The bundled Java runtime does not include it. Install a JDK 25 and choose jcmd (jcmd.exe on Windows) in its bin directory.
integratedDiagnostics.truncated: {{count}} older log lines were omitted. Full server logs remain in the data directory.
integratedDiagnostics.privacy: Reports include local paths and recent logs. Review reports and thread dumps for personal information before sharing. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

discover.noPluginsDescription: This Soulfire server does not offer any plugins for this project.
discover.scope: Plugins add behavior to every bot in this project. Turning one on takes effect for bots right away.

sdk.title: SDK quickstart
sdk.description: Use this connection and project in a local script, or copy a prompt for your coding agent.
sdk.connectionDescription: Uses the Soulfire API address this app is connected to.
sdk.tokenHelp: Keep this token private. It grants your user permissions. This page keeps the generated token in memory until you leave.
sdk.tokenSetupHelp: Generate a personal API token to run locally. Examples and agent prompts read it from SOULFIRE_TOKEN.
sdk.impersonatingHelp: Stop impersonating to generate your own API token. You can still copy examples and agent prompts.
sdk.tokenPermission: Ask your administrator for a personal API token if you cannot generate one. Paste it into your terminal command.
sdk.tokenRetry: Try again or ask your administrator for API access.
sdk.demoBody: Demo values are shown in the examples. Replace the server URL and target IDs to run them.
sdk.missingUrlHelp: Reconnect to your Soulfire server to get a usable API address.
sdk.localHelp: Run the script on the same computer as this app. A localhost address points to the computer running the script.
sdk.integratedHelp: Keep Soulfire and its local server running while you use the SDK.
sdk.noBotsTitle: Add an account to choose a bot
sdk.noBotsBody: You can list bots now. Add an account to this project before you read a bot state or send chat.
sdk.stoppedBody: Start it from the Bots page before you run the chat example.
sdk.saveScript: Save this code as {{filename}} in a new folder. The script reads your token from SOULFIRE_TOKEN.
sdk.pythonRequirement: Requires Python 3.14 or newer. These commands create a virtual environment in your script folder.
sdk.typescriptRequirement: Requires Bun. Open a terminal in your script folder, then install the SDK.
sdk.replaceToken: Replace PASTE_YOUR_API_TOKEN with your personal token. Run both commands in the same terminal.
sdk.version: SDK {{version}}. Examples close their API connection when finished.

list-bots.title: List bots
list-bots.description: Read the names, IDs, and connection states of the bots in this project.
list-bots.expected: Expect a list of bots in your terminal. An empty project returns an empty list.

read-state.title: Read state
read-state.description: Read the latest live state for one bot. A disconnected bot can have no live state.
read-state.expected: Expect the selected bot's live state in your terminal. This example does not start the bot.

send-chat.title: Send chat
send-chat.description: Send one public message as a connected bot when you run this script. Requires permission to send chat.
send-chat.expected: Expect “Hello from the Soulfire SDK!” in Minecraft chat, then “Message sent.” in your terminal.

connection.title: Connection refused or timed out
connection.body: Keep the Soulfire server running. Use its API address. For a local address, run your script on the same computer. Check remote network access.

authentication.title: Authentication or permission denied
authentication.body: Use a personal API token generated for this Soulfire server. The token keeps your user permissions. Ask the administrator for any missing access.

compatibility.title: SDK or API version mismatch
compatibility.body: The SDK checks compatibility when it connects. Use a compatible Soulfire server and SDK release. Follow the version guidance in the SDK guide.
